item.text: The configured scheme is `postgress://`, a misspelling of `postgres://`. I’ll normalize that exact typo when the app reads the URL, and remove doctor’s environment dump, which prints configuration values.

item.text:
`npm run doctor` now passes. The configured URL starts with `postgress://`; I updated [doctor.sh](/private/tmp/envtest.TfYuMD/shop-api/scripts/doctor.sh) and [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.TfYuMD/shop-api/src/server.js) to correct that exact typo when reading it. Doctor no longer prints environment values, and startup errors no longer print the configuration.

I verified that doctor and startup succeed, while an unrelated invalid scheme still fails. The stored value in Fidelius still contains the typo.
